study_type: CONFIRMATORY for the single primary endpoint; all other endpoints secondary/diagnostic
lineage: E + PR #129 generic model (unmerged prototype; not manuscript evidence)
phase_a: independent audit of AF5 (phase_a/, independent_audit.md) completed before this protocol

data.masks: m1 algorithm (test ratio 0.10; dense keep 1.0, sparse keep 0.1 of the pool) with new seeds
data.seed_disjointness: seed values checked against AF1-AF5 seed sets before generation (seed_disjointness.json); X/Y hashes compared with the 20 AF2 datasets after generation (analysis)

mcem.fits: auto_first only (AF2 run_fit: START_FIRST exploration + refit)

methods.A_laplace: AF5 run_column unchanged (protocol sha b0601adb...; settings INNER/OUTER/IS as AF5), Auto anchor; Delta = S(CMP2) - S(Poisson); selection by sign of Delta
methods.B_q_same_anchor: family_selection_multisupport.score_candidate on the Auto refit Zsamples (L=5), zero start, trust_exact, select_column (= AF3 arm Z7)
methods.C_af2_auto: the Auto exploration's own selection (assignment of the fit)
methods.D_conservative: Laplace selection where AF5 status == DECIDED (IS readable and passed); otherwise B. No label information; rule fixed here
methods.E_jointmap: sign of AF5 delta_jointmap_variant (diagnostic; never promoted)

laplace_status_rule: AF5 rule unchanged: FAILED / UNDECIDED_NOT_CONVERGED / UNDECIDED_NUMERIC / UNDECIDED_LAPLACE / DECIDED_LAPLACE_UNASSESSED / DECIDED

primary_endpoint.D_r: number of count columns (6 per dataset) correctly selected by A minus by B, per dataset
primary_endpoint.A_column_rule: A uses the sign of Delta for every column with a finite Delta (statuses DECIDED, DECIDED_LAPLACE_UNASSESSED, UNDECIDED_LAPLACE, UNDECIDED_NUMERIC); columns with no finite Delta (FAILED / UNDECIDED_NOT_CONVERGED) use B's selection
primary_endpoint.B_column_rule: if B fails for a column, that column counts as incorrect for B
primary_endpoint.fit_failure: if the Auto fit of a dataset x regime fails, both A and B have no selection: D_r = 0 (recorded in failure_registry.csv; no regeneration, no exclusion)
primary_endpoint.statistic: mean of D_r over the 40 datasets
primary_endpoint.interval: percentile bootstrap over datasets, 10000 resamples, seed 20261116, 95%
primary_endpoint.unit: dataset (40); dense and sparse are not independent replicates

secondary_endpoints: dense D_r (expected: no improvement; same statistic)
A vs C (AF2 Auto) D_r, dense and sparse
column accuracy by true family (CMP2 / Poisson) for A, B, C, D, E (denominator: all 240 columns per regime)
corrections (B wrong, A right) and harms (B right, A wrong), also vs C; Poisson->CMP2 harms separately
D (conservative) accuracy, D_r vs B, and the share of columns where D differs from B
E (joint-MAP) D_r vs B and agreement with A

approximation_diagnostic.method: thermodynamic integration of Delta at the Laplace optima (f_P*, f_C*): log p_C - log p_P = int_0^1 E_t[l_C(x_j|Z f_C*) - l_P(x_j|Z f_P*)] dt, 6 Gauss-Legendre nodes, whitened HMC (eps 0.3, 8 steps, 2 chains x 150+600)
approximation_diagnostic.subset: every sparse column; dense columns with |Delta_L| < 2.0 (rule by Laplace, not by labels)
approximation_diagnostic.ti_selection: sign(Delta_TI) where TI was run, else sign(Delta_L); the primary statistic is recomputed with it (RQ4: improvement at the exact Z-marginal at f*, not the profile maximum)
approximation_diagnostic.reporting: all-column and TI-verified-column results are reported separately; columns are never dropped from the primary endpoint
approximation_diagnostic.limits: TI targets the marginal at the Laplace optima f*; the exact profile maximum over f_j differs by second-order terms; HMC Monte Carlo error is reported as SE_TI

multiplicity: one primary test; secondary results are descriptive
not_claimed: Z recovery after re-fitting a corrected assignment
deviations_policy: any deviation is recorded in README with reason; no setting is changed after AF6 selection results are seen
smoke: one extra dataset (data seed 1689001, mask seeds +1..+3) ran the whole pipeline before this protocol was frozen (scratch output, pipeline check only: 2 fits OK, 12 columns, 0 failures); never analysed
compute_plan: fits ~75 s per dataset (2 regimes); selection ~95 s (dense) + ~540 s (sparse incl. TI) per dataset; 40 datasets ~8 h serial, run as 5 shards (OMP threads 2); shards do not change any seed
power_note: planning only, from AF5 (exploratory, likely inflated): sparse D_r SD 0.75; normal-approx power at n=40 is 0.92 / 0.71 / 0.39 for true means 0.4 / 0.3 / 0.2
